description: This file contains the implementation of the MotionHandler class for handling motion activity and pedometer data on Android devices, along with related data classes, interface, and a system data source implementation that interacts with device sensors.

classes.name: MotionDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods to check sensor availability, permissions, and to retrieve motion activity and pedometer data.

classes.name: SystemMotionDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object providing system sensor interactions for motion data, implementing MotionDataSource interface.

classes.name: AccelerometerSample
classes.description: Data class holding accelerometer sample count and average delta calculations.

classes.name: MotionHandler
classes.description: Main class that handles motion activity and pedometer requests, utilizing a data source to gather sensor data and returning results suitable for use in an Android app.

methods.name: isMotionCapabilityAvailable
methods.description: Static method to check if device hardware supports motion capabilities.

methods.name: forTesting
methods.description: Factory method for creating a MotionHandler instance with a custom data source for testing purposes.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity
methods.description: Handles a request for current motion activity, returns result as a GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer
methods.description: Handles a request for current pedometer data, returns result as a GatewaySession.InvokeResult.
